cards.name: Mickey Mouse - Brave Little Tailor
cards.cardText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)

When defeat looms and victory hangs by a thread, a hero bolts to the rescue, patching things up with sheer determination.

cards.name: Cinderella - Stouthearted
cards.cardText:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Cinderella.)
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)
THE SINGING SWORD Whenever you play a song, this character can challenge ready characters this turn.

cards.name: Ursula - Deceiver
cards.cardText: YOU'LL NEVER EVEN MISS IT When you play this card, chosen opponent reveals their hand and discards a song card of your choice.

cards.name: Bruno Madrigal - Undetected Uncle
cards.cardText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
YOU JUST HAVE TO SEE IT {E} – Name a card, then reveal the top card of your deck. If it’s the named card, put that card into your hand and gain 3 lore. Otherwise, put it on the top of your deck.

cards.name: Vanellope Von Schweetz - Sugar Rush Princess
cards.cardText:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Vanellope von Schweetz.)
I HEREBY DECREE Whenever you play another Princess character, all opposing characters get -1 {S} until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Oswald - The Lucky Rabbit
cards.cardText: FAVORABLE CHANCE During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an item card, you may play that item for free and they enter play exerted. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse - Playful Sorcerer
cards.cardText:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Mickey Mouse.)
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
SWEEP AWAY When you play this character, deal damage to chosen character equal to the number of Broom characters you have in play.

cards.name: Iago - Out of Reach
cards.cardText:
SELF-PRESERVATION While you have another exerted character in play, this character can't be challenged.

"Nice try, chumps! Too bad I'm all the way up here!"

cards.name: Woody - Leader of the Toys
cards.cardText: LET'S GO HOME When you play this character, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Toy character card or a location card named Andy's Room and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Angel - Siren Singer
cards.cardText:
UNDERDOG If this is your first turn and you're not the first player, you pay 1 {I} less to play this character.
Singer 3 (This character counts as cost 3 to sing songs.)

cards.name: Pocahontas - Following the Wind
cards.cardText:
WHAT IS MY PATH? Whenever this character quests, gain lore equal to another chosen exerted character's {L}.

"She has her mother's spirit. She goes wherever the wind takes her."
—Kekata

cards.name: Mushu - Stealthy Dragon
cards.cardText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
TIP THE SCALES Whenever this character quests, if an opponent has more cards in their hand than you, you may draw a card.

cards.name: Héctor Rivera - Gone to Pieces
cards.cardText:
Singer 6 (This character counts as cost 6 to sing songs.)
FEEL THE MUSIC While you have a song card in your discard, this character gets +1 {L} and gains Evasive. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)

cards.name: Judy Hopps - Uncovering Clues
cards.cardText: THOROUGH INVESTIGATION When you play this character and whenever she quests, look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Detective character card and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Mr. Incredible - Taking Out the Trash
cards.cardText:
KA-POW! When you play this character, you may deal 2 damage to chosen opposing Robot or Villain character.

"Heavyweight problems need heavyweight solutions."
—Mr. Incredible

cards.name: Mad Hatter - Unruly Eccentric
cards.cardText:
UNBIRTHDAY PRESENT Whenever a damaged character challenges another character, you may draw a card.

"Don't you care for tea?"
